description: Global maps: time-averaged visible share of the Sun's and of the Earth's disc above the terrain horizon.
layout: row 0 = northernmost, column 0 = westernmost (longitude -180 deg); values at cell centres
frame: MOON_ME (mean Earth / polar axis, DE421), east longitude positive

method.horizon: 72 directions per cell, from 15.2 km to 300 km every 7.6 km, observer 2 m above the ground, exact spherical geometry
method.visible: area of the disc above a straight horizon line at the azimuth of the disc centre; Sun radius 0.2666 deg; Earth radius from its distance, seen from the cell

sources.terrain: data/globe/ldem_me_1440x720.bin (LOLA LDEM64, area means on 0.25 deg cells)

limits: The ground is only as fine as the grid (7.6 km cells). Small permanently shadowed craters and lit rims near the poles are not resolved.

layers.name: sunlight
layers.title: Mean sunlight
layers.dtype: uint8, value / 255 = share of the disc in view, averaged over the year
layers.note: 2027, every second hour. Ground: LOLA global grid, 7.6 km cells; features under 15 km are not resolved.

layers.name: earth
layers.title: Earth in view
layers.dtype: uint8, value / 255 = share of the disc in view, averaged over the year
layers.note: 2027, every second hour. Ground: LOLA global grid, 7.6 km cells; features under 15 km are not resolved.
